summary.en: Elgato audio mixing app for streamers with a separate arm64 MSIX package.
summary.zh-TW: Elgato 為實況主打造的音訊混音應用程式，另有 arm64 MSIX 安裝套件。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: The app is native, but Elgato hardware and its drivers were not tested on RTX Spark.
caveats.zh-TW: 應用程式為原生版本，但 Elgato 硬體與驅動程式未在 RTX Spark 上測試。
